# FDG4064

> DO declare a strongly typed string as an immutable value type (`struct`) with a string constructor.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 4.11 Strongly Typed Strings.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

Not an analyzer candidate: whether a type is a strongly typed string is a matter of intent that symbols do not show. The readonly modifier and IEquatable&lt;T> are checked for every struct (FDG4028, FDG4032).

## From the book

The strongly typed string type should follow other guidance for immutable value types, such as using the `readonly` modifier on the type and implementing `IEquatable<T>`.
